answer: New agents must each complete a 48-hour sequential verifiable-delay function bound to their public key, verified on-chain. Since the cipher chain cannot be parallelized, minting 10,000 sybils burns 10,000 slots for 48 hours each (~$4,000 cloud cost per wave), while an honest agent pays only idle background cycles. Registrations pass through an admission lagoon so bulk floods arrive as a trickle, letting juries flag clustered signups before payouts vest. A signed sonnet-of-work attestation proves the key holder did the work, so resold identities are useless without the solver's hardware.
